ticker_news.title: 2 Tech Stocks You Can Buy and Hold for the Next Decade
ticker_news.description: The article discusses two leading technology stocks, Alphabet and Salesforce, that investors should consider buying and holding for the next decade. Alphabet is seen as a bargain due to its dominance in search, YouTube, and cloud computing, as well as its potential to monetize AI. Salesforce is highlighted for its leadership in customer relationship management and its new agentic AI platform, Agentforce.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: Nvidia Q4 Earnings Preview: A Make-or-Break Moment for the AI Trade?
ticker_news.description: Nvidia's Q4 earnings report will be a crucial test for the tech sector and the broader market, as investors assess the sustainability of the AI boom. A strong performance could boost sentiment, while a disappointment could trigger a market correction.
ticker_news.author: Jesse Cohen
